items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: I'd played opposite many musicians, Dizzy Gillespie, (inaudible) Charlie Parker.

ctx.x: Oh, is that what he was.

Very trained. And he come up to Dizzy one night in Philadelphia and asked him could he sit in, had his horn under his arm, and Diz said, sure, come on up, boy. He didn't know Joe from anybody else, and Joe got up there and played. He said, where (inaudible) upset Dizzy's nerve. Joe
